HeartShell.note: Muscular pump that drives blood through pulmonary and systemic circuits. Four chambers: RA, LA, RV, LV.

HeartRA.note: Receives deoxygenated blood from the venae cavae and empties into the right ventricle.

HeartLA.note: Receives oxygenated blood from the pulmonary veins and empties into the left ventricle.

HeartRV.note: Pumps deoxygenated blood into the pulmonary trunk toward the lungs.

HeartLV.note: Thick-walled chamber that pumps oxygenated blood into the aorta for the body.

HeartTricuspid.note: Three-cusp valve between right atrium and right ventricle.

HeartMitral.note: Bicuspid valve between left atrium and left ventricle.

HeartAortic.note: Semilunar valve guarding outflow from the left ventricle into the aorta.

HeartPulmonary.note: Semilunar valve between right ventricle and pulmonary trunk.

LungLeft.note: Two-lobed lung; site of gas exchange with the blood.

LungRight.note: Three-lobed lung; site of gas exchange with the blood.

Liver.note: Largest internal organ; metabolism, detoxification, and bile production.

Stomach.note: Muscular sac that stores food and begins protein digestion.

KidneyLeft.note: Filters blood, balances fluids/electrolytes, and forms urine.

KidneyRight.note: Filters blood, balances fluids/electrolytes, and forms urine.

Brain.note: Central organ of the nervous system controlling thought, sensation, and movement.

SkinShell.note: Outer protective covering (epidermis + dermis). Peel this layer to reveal muscles underneath.
